name: Startups
descriptor: Cover the role with talent that already works with AI.

heroImage.alt: A small team working on laptops around a shared table in a coworking café

subhead: Get startup roles off your plate, owned by talent that already works with AI.
problemBody: The company is growing, and now there is more work than there are people to do it. You are still running support, ops, and the books yourself at night.
triggers: You are growing faster than you can hire, and you are covering the gap yourself.
A US hire for this role costs more runway than you can give it.
This is your first 3rd party hire, and you are not sure how to get it right.
You tried a freelancer and spent more time managing them than the work gave back.
rolesHeadline: Here are the roles we fill most for startups
rolesCloser: Talent you pick yourself, in your working hours, with client-ready English and real AI skills, there to own the role and not just clear tasks.
